column1: empathetic§The most empathetic nurse on the ward was also the one who burned out first, which the hospital treated as a coincidence.§病房里最**善于共情的**护士也是最先耗竭的那个，而医院把这当成了巧合。§em-（进入）+ path（感情，同 sympathy 同情）→ 走进别人的感受里
emphatic§Her denial was emphatic and, as the recordings later showed, entirely accurate on every point that mattered.§她的否认**语气坚决**，而录音后来显示，在每个要紧的点上都完全准确。§em-（在内）+ phas（显示）→ 说得分量重
empiric§The old empiric cured more patients than the licensed physician, and neither of them could explain why.§这位老**经验派医者**治好的病人比持照医生还多，两人都说不清缘由。§em-（在内）+ peir（尝试，同 experiment 实验）
empirical§The claim is empirical, so it can be tested, and four attempts to test it have now failed.§这个论断是**经验性的**，因此可以检验，而迄今四次检验尝试都失败了。§
emporium§The emporium sold everything from pianos to potatoes, and its collapse emptied four streets of shoppers.§这家**大商场**从钢琴到土豆什么都卖，它的倒闭让四条街失去了顾客。§
emptiness§The emptiness of the argument is disguised by its length: nine pages that could be reduced to one assertion.§这番论证的**空洞**被它的篇幅掩盖了——九页可以压缩成一句断言。§
emulate§Younger firms tried to emulate the model without noticing that its success depended on one unrepeatable contract.§后来的公司试图**效仿**这一模式，却没注意到它的成功依赖一份无法复制的合同。§aemul（竞争）
enable§A single change in the licensing rules enabled four hundred small producers to sell directly to shops.§许可规则的一处改动让四百家小生产者**得以**直接向商店供货。§en-（使）+ able（能）
enact§Parliament enacted the ban in 1991, and the first prosecution under it came eleven years later.§议会于 1991 年**颁布**这项禁令，依它提起的第一桩诉讼在十一年后。§en-（使）+ act（行动）
enchant§The recording enchanted a generation that had never heard the instrument played without amplification.§这段录音**迷住**了一代从未听过这件乐器不加扩音演奏的人。§en-（使）+ chant（吟唱，同 chant 吟诵）→ 唱咒语迷人
encompass§The survey encompasses four counties and misses the one where the problem was first reported.§这项调查**涵盖**四个郡，却漏掉了最早报告问题的那一个。§en-（在内）+ compass（范围）
encore§The audience demanded an encore that the pianist had not prepared, and what he played instead is now famous.§观众要求**返场加演**，而钢琴家没有准备，他临时弹的曲子如今很有名。§
encounter§Her first encounter with the archive lasted nine hours, and she came out with the subject of the next four years.§她与这座档案馆的初次**相遇**持续了九小时，出来时带着此后四年的题目。§en-（在内）+ counter（相对）→ 迎面碰上
encroach§Housing has encroached on the floodplain for thirty years, and every new estate makes the next flood worse.§三十年来住宅不断**侵占**洪泛区，每一片新楼盘都让下一场洪水更严重。§en-（在内）+ croach（钩子，同 crochet 钩针）→ 一点点钩过来
encumbrance§The old software became an encumbrance rather than an asset, and replacing it cost more than writing it had.§这套旧软件成了**累赘**而非资产，替换它的花费超过当初编写它。§en-（使）+ cumber（阻碍）
endemic§Corruption here is endemic rather than occasional: it is how the system works, not how it fails.§这里的腐败是**地方性痼疾**而非偶发——它是系统运作的方式，不是系统失灵的方式。§en-（在内）+ dem（人民，同 democracy 民主）→ 长在这群人里
endorse§Four former ministers endorsed the plan, and none of them had read past the executive summary.§四位前部长**背书**了这项计划，而他们都没读过执行摘要之后的内容。§en-（在上）+ dors（背，同 dorsal 背部的）→ 在背面签字
endorsement§The endorsement was worth more than the money: doors opened that eleven years of applications had not.§这份**背书**比钱更值钱——它打开了十一年申请都没打开的门。§
endure§The bridge has endured four floods that destroyed everything else within nine miles of it.§这座桥**挺过**了四场洪水，而九英里内的其他一切都被摧毁了。§en-（在内）+ dur（坚硬，同 durable 耐久的）
enervate§The heat enervated the crew so thoroughly that a two-hour job took most of the afternoon.§酷热让船员**衰弱无力**，两小时的活儿耗掉了大半个下午。§e-（出）+ nerv（筋腱，同 nerve 神经）→ 抽掉筋力
enforce§Nobody enforced the rule for a decade, and the first person penalized under it sued and won.§这条规则十年无人**执行**，第一个依它受罚的人起诉并胜诉了。§en-（使）+ force（力量）
enfranchise§The act enfranchised two million people and left another four million exactly where they had been.§这项法案让两百万人**获得选举权**，另外四百万人的处境则原封未动。§en-（使）+ franchise（自由权）
engage§The exhibition engages children in a way no amount of labelling ever did, because it lets them touch things.§这个展览以任何说明牌都做不到的方式**吸引**孩子，因为它允许触摸。§en-（使）+ gage（抵押）→ 把人拴住
enhance§Better lighting enhanced the reading room so much that use rose forty percent in a single term.§更好的照明**提升**了阅览室的品质，一个学期内使用率就上升了四成。§en-（使）+ hance ← alt（高，同 altitude 高度）
enigma§The building's purpose remains an enigma: no plans survive, and it faces away from the road entirely.§这栋建筑的用途仍是个**谜**——图纸无存，而且它整个背对着道路。§
enigmatic§Her enigmatic reply satisfied both factions, which is presumably why she chose it over a clear one.§她**高深莫测的**回复让两派都满意，这大概就是她舍明确答案而取它的原因。§
enjoin§The court enjoined the company from felling any tree until the survey was complete.§法院**禁止**该公司在勘察完成前砍伐任何树木。§en-（使）+ join（连接／命令，同 junction 交汇）
enlighten§One diagram enlightened the committee more than three hundred pages of text had managed in six months.§一张图**启发**委员会的程度，超过三百页文字在六个月里所能做到的。§en-（使）+ light（光）
enormous§The enormous cost of the delay was never published, and the figure appears in no report anyone can find.§这次延误的**巨大**代价从未公布，任何人能找到的报告里都没有这个数字。§e-（出）+ norm（标准，同 normal 正常的）→ 出了常规的大
enrage§The tone of the letter enraged exactly the people whom its actual content would almost certainly have persuaded.§这封信的语气恰恰**激怒**了那些本来几乎肯定会被它实际内容说服的人。§en-（使）+ rage（暴怒）
ensemble§The ensemble has played together for nineteen years, and you can hear it in how they breathe between phrases.§这个**合奏团**已合作十九年，从他们乐句之间的换气就听得出来。§
ensure§Two independent checks ensure that no single mistake can reach the patient, and both were skipped that night.§两道独立核查**确保**没有单一错误能到达病人，而那晚两道都被跳过了。§en-（使）+ sure（确定）
entangle§The company entangled itself in nine separate leases and could not exit any of them without breaching another.§这家公司把自己**缠进**九份互不相干的租约，退出任何一份都会违反另一份。§en-（使）+ tangle（缠结）
entertain§She entertained the possibility for about four seconds and then explained, patiently, why it could not be true.§她**考虑**了这种可能性约四秒，然后耐心解释了它为何不可能成立。§enter（在中间）+ tain（拿住，同 contain 容纳）→ 把念头留住
enthrall§The story enthralled listeners for six centuries before anyone thought to write down where it came from.§这个故事**迷住**听众六个世纪，才有人想到记下它的来处。§en-（使）+ thrall（奴隶）→ 让人成了它的奴隶
enthusiasm§Enthusiasm carried the project through year one and could not carry it through the funding review.§**热情**撑着项目度过了第一年，却撑不过经费评审。§en-（在内）+ theos（神，同 theology 神学）→ 神附体的劲头
enthusiastically§She enthusiastically supported a proposal that, four months later, cost her department half its staff.§她**热情地**支持了一项四个月后让她部门失去一半人手的提案。§
entourage§The minister's entourage filled the whole first floor, and the meeting itself involved three people.§这位部长的**随行人员**占满了整个一楼，而会议本身只涉及三个人。§
entrench§Forty years of unexamined practice entrenched a method that no piece of evidence has ever actually supported.§四十年无人质疑的惯例**牢固确立**了一种从未真正有证据支持的方法。§en-（使）+ trench（壕沟）→ 挖壕固守
entrepreneur§The entrepreneur failed four times before the fifth attempt, and only the fifth appears in any profile of her.§这位**创业者**失败四次才有第五次尝试，而任何关于她的报道都只写第五次。§
entrust§They entrusted the archive to a volunteer who catalogued it for nine years without ever asking for payment.§他们把档案**托付**给一位志愿者，他编目九年从未要过报酬。§en-（使）+ trust（信任）
envelop§Fog enveloped the valley for eleven days, and the airport lost more flights than in the previous two years.§大雾**笼罩**河谷十一天，机场取消的航班比此前两年加起来还多。§en-（在内）+ velop（包，同 develop 展开）
envision§Nobody envisioned that the tool would be used mainly by people it was never designed for.§没有人**预想**到这个工具最终主要被它从未为之设计的人使用。§en-（使）+ vis（看，同 vision 视觉）
ephemeral§The gains were ephemeral: the index recovered in April and gave everything back by the end of June.§这些涨幅是**短暂的**——指数四月回升，到六月底全数回吐。§epi-（在上）+ hemer（一天）→ 只活一天
epistolary§The epistolary novel demands patience: eleven letters pass before the reader learns who is writing to whom.§这部**书信体**小说需要耐心——过了十一封信读者才弄清谁在给谁写。§epistol（书信，同 epistle 使徒书）
epitome§The building is the epitome of the period: expensive, confident, and impossible to heat in winter.§这栋建筑是那个时代的**缩影**——昂贵、自信，冬天怎么也烧不暖。§epi-（在上）+ tom（切，同 atom 原子）→ 切出来的精华
epitomize§One photograph epitomizes the whole decade, and the man who took it was paid nine dollars for it.§一张照片**集中体现**了整个十年，而拍摄它的人为此拿了九美元。§
equanimity§She received the verdict with an equanimity that unsettled the reporters far more than tears would have.§她以一种**平静镇定**接受了判决，这比眼泪更让记者不安。§equ（平等，同 equal 相等）+ anim（心气，同 animate 赋予生气）
equitable§An equitable solution would cost the city nothing and has been available since the first complaint in 2009.§一个**公平的**解决方案不会让市里花一分钱，而它自 2009 年首次投诉起就摆在那里。§equ（平等，同 equal 相等）
equivocal§The test result was equivocal, and the decision to operate rested entirely on how the surgeon read one shadow.§检验结果**模棱两可**，是否手术完全取决于外科医生如何解读一处阴影。§equi（相等）+ voc（声音，同 voice 声音）→ 两种说法一样响
equivocate§He equivocated for twenty minutes and then gave an answer that contradicted everything he had just said.§他**含糊其辞**了二十分钟，随后给出一个与刚才所言处处矛盾的回答。§
eradicate§Smallpox was eradicated by a campaign that spent most of its budget on finding the last four hundred cases.§天花被一场运动**根除**，其预算大部分花在寻找最后四百个病例上。§e-（出）+ radic（根，同 radish 萝卜）→ 连根拔出
eradication§Eradication is far harder than control: the last one percent costs more than the first ninety-nine.§**根除**远比控制困难——最后百分之一的花费超过前面的百分之九十九。§
eradicative§The eradicative approach failed twice, and the programme that finally worked aimed only at keeping numbers low.§**根除式的**做法失败了两次，最终奏效的方案只求把数量压低。§
erode§Rain eroded the earth wall by about a centimetre a year, and nobody measured it until the wall fell.§雨水每年**侵蚀**土墙约一厘米，直到墙塌了才有人去量。§e-（出）+ rod（啃，同 rodent 啮齿动物）
erosion§The erosion of trust was gradual and then total, and no single event marks the point of no return.§信任的**流失**先是渐进随后彻底，没有任何单一事件标出不可挽回的那一刻。§
erratic§The instrument's readings were erratic for six weeks before anyone considered that the instrument might be broken.§这台仪器的读数**飘忽不定**了六周，才有人想到仪器可能坏了。§err（走错，同 error 错误）→ 乱走
erratically§The engine ran erratically at altitude, and the pilot landed at the first field long enough to take him.§发动机在高空运转**不稳**，飞行员在第一块够长的场地降落。§
erroneous§The erroneous figure was repeated in nine publications before someone went back to the original survey.§这个**错误的**数字在九份出版物中被重复，才有人回去查原始调查。§
erudite§His erudite footnotes are the best part of a book whose main text almost nobody finishes.§他**博学的**脚注是全书最好的部分，而正文几乎没人读得完。§e-（出）+ rud（粗糙，同 rude 粗鲁的）→ 磨掉了粗野
erudition§Her erudition never showed as display: she used it to make hard things simple, not to make simple things hard.§她的**博学**从不用来炫耀——她用它把难事化简，而非把简单的事弄难。§
escalate§A parking dispute escalated into a lawsuit that occupied two families for eleven years.§一场停车纠纷**升级**成一桩官司，占据了两个家庭十一年。§e-（向上）+ scal（梯子，同 scale 攀登）
eschew§The author eschews adjectives almost entirely, and the effect over three hundred pages is oddly powerful.§这位作者几乎完全**避用**形容词，三百页下来效果出奇地有力。§
esoteric§The debate is esoteric and the stakes are not: what these four people decide sets rates for the whole country.§这场辩论**深奥难解**，利害关系却不是——这四个人的决定为全国定下费率。§eso（内部）→ 只在圈内传的
espouse§He espoused the cause publicly in 1978 and quietly funded it for the twenty years before that.§他 1978 年公开**支持**这项事业，而在此前二十年一直悄悄资助它。§es-（出）+ spous（承诺，同 spouse 配偶）→ 许身于某事
essential§Only one clause is essential, and the other eleven pages exist to make the first one enforceable.§只有一条条款是**必不可少的**，其余十一页的存在是为了让第一条可执行。§ess（存在）→ 本质所在
establish§The trust was established in 1904 to run for fifty years and has now outlived its purpose by seventy.§这项信托于 1904 年**设立**，原定运行五十年，如今超出其目的七十年了。§stabl（稳固，同 stable 稳定的）
